newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sri Lanka buys Jan diesel/jet fuel from Shell.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka buys Jan diesel/jet fuel from Shell.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp bought diesel and jet fuel by tender from Shell Singapore for January 3-4 delivery on a cost-and-fright (c-and-f) basis to Colombo, a CPC official said on Friday.

The 185,000 barrels of 1.0-percent sulphur diesel were purchased at a premium of 81.5 cents per barrel to Singapore spot quotes, while the 40,000 barrels of jet fuel were bought at a premium of 79.5 cents.

In its last tender, Sri Lanka bought from BB Energy 160,000 barrels of diesel and 40,000 barrels of jet fuel at a 98-cent premium to Singapore spot quotes, for December 19-20 delivery, c-and-f Colombo.
